notes.title: ATAN - Hotfix #3
notes.content:
[b]Hey there![/b]

This week in preparation for an game industry event we improvement some elements of our game. The following things have been fixed and/or changed:

[h2]Fixes & Changes[/h2] 
[list]
[*] Gameplay - Mantling has been improved, the 'double mantling' issue is now resolved in most instances
[*] Gameplay - Mantling end position has been improved
[*] Gameplay - Fall volume has been increased to prevent people falling out of the level
[*] UI/UX - Current arrow will now always show at low opacity 
[*] UI/UX - Swap animation in level select has been adjusted
[*] UI/UX - Text readability improved in certain sections
[*] Animation - After cinematics, the reference to the Player's hand is now set again, so the rope properly goes through the player 
[/list]

From here on out the developers of ATAN will less regularly update the game. We will be moving onwards to new projects and other endeavors. We want to thank you again for checking our game out. It means the world to us. 

Have a great summer o/

notes.title: ATAN Patch 1.1 - 'Quality of Life'
notes.content:
[b]Hey There[/b]
A week has passed since ATAN has fully released. Since then our developers have focused on polishing the game's systems and adding some Quality of Life features and a lot of fixes that should improve the overall experience of the game.

For all the people that have been following our development, thank you for playing our game!
As a group of students aspiring to break into the game industry, it means a lot to us that our game has been positively received. 

Also an extra thank you to some of our community members that highlighted some issues for us that we could fix:
[list]
[*] DipG
[*] Poncho Rutzzo
[*] Bigbob40
[*] Tenasow
[/list]
Without further ado, here are all the changes from this patch:

[h2]Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Achievement - There are now achievements for collecting all the goobers per level and one for collecting all of them in every level.

[*] Audio - New song in the later half of Chahuk
[*] Audio - Settings now have a better default profile
[*] Audio - Completing puzzles relating to lightning now plays a SFX
[*] Audio - Swapping arrows now plays a SFX
[*] Audio - More vegetation has ambience audio
[*] Audio - Cricket sound effects in Chahuk
[*] Audio - Wind sound effects play while swinging with the rope
[*] Audio - SFXs for when you repel upwards or downwards with the rope

[*] Art - Tree in Olis received new wind effects
[*] Art - Leaves can now be spotted near trees in every level
[*] Art - More set dressing in different areas of Olis
[*] Art - New goober masks have been added
[*] Art - New murals in Olis & Mijin
[*] Art - Start area of Mijin received new art assets

[*] UI/UX - Sensitivity slider for both mouse & controller
[*] UI/UX - Volume sliders for SFX & Music
[*] UI/UX - Menu transition animations from Main Menu, Level Select and settings
[*] UI/UX - Navigating option boxes now plays SFXs
[*] UI/UX - New popup prompt whenever the settings have been applied
[*] UI/UX - More images to the settings have been added
[*] UI/UX - More descriptions to what the settings do have been added
[*] UI/UX - New setting that allows you to toggle sprint on hold

[*] VFX - New VFX for the end of Chahuk
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Audio - Timing for the credits song has improved
[*] Audio - Overall volume of ambience has been increased

[*] UI/UX - Updating keybind settings now reflect used inputs
[*] UI/UX - Resetting to default settings now resets all relevant settings

[*] Art - Story Tablets have been adjusted for better facing during cinematic
[*] Art - Leaf material has been updated
[*] Art - Tree material for Olis and Chahuk has been updated
[*] Art - More wall paintings have been added in Olis 
[*] Art - Old textures replaced with newer ones in Olis
[*] Art - Goobers now emit a bit of light
[*] Art - Color of the rope has been adjusted 
[*] Art - Color adjustments to some of the bushes & plants
[*] Art - The eagle targets have been retextured to better fit the environment
[*] Art - More vertex painting has been done on the rocks, making them stand out more

[*] Gameplay - Climbing system has improved to prevent clipping into moving surfaces while climbing
[*] Gameplay - New max rope length has been set
[*] Gameplay - First gear section in Olis has been adjusted so it cannot be as easily skipped
[*] Gameplay - Legs clip less through objects while mantling 
[*] Gameplay - Collision of goober houses have been improved
[*] Gameplay - When the player starts a level ( not via 'Continue' ) they will be brought back to the first checkpoint
[*] Gameplay - When you already have a max amount of anchor upgrades, you don't receive anymore upgrades from the Goobers
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Audio - Music now plays when a player continues when they quit within a music area
[*] Audio - Moving meshes with audio now properly update with their moving position
[*] Audio - Anchor container doesn't player water splash SFX anymore
[*] Audio - When falling into the water in Mijin, splash SFXs play again

[*] Art - Broken geometry has been fixed on the Axis of the wheel
[*] Art - Some meshes that shouldn't be visible are now hidden in game
[*] Art - Tree at the end of Chahuk has now a minimum LOD, to avoid too low poly geometry
[*] Art - Some geometry in Olis has been removed that was sticking out of the climbable surfaces
[*] Art - In Chahuk, the architecture materials have been updated to the correct material
[*] Art - Shadows on some foliage in Mijin have been disabled to solve shadow artifacts
[*] Art - Some floating rocks in Olis have been removed
[*] Art - Player doesn't have a feather clipping in the floor anymore with new save data

[*] Gameplay - Collision on plant in Chahuk has been disabled
[*] Gameplay - Fixed places where the player could get stuck in geometry in Olis
[*] Gameplay - Fixed issue where player wouldn't be able to move anymore after reloading to the last checkpoint while respawning
[*] Gameplay - Fixed mantling issue at the end of the onboarding section of Olis
[*] Gameplay - Disabled collision on shadow blockers to prevent players from reaching non-playable zones
[*] Gameplay - Issue fixed where the pendulum in Chahuk would get out of sync with the other elements of the challenge

[*] UI/UX - Main Menu no longer shows on top of the settings menu
[*] UI/UX - Fixed an issue where you could un-pause the game with the exit prompt still open

[*] VFX - Impact Effect on Barnacles is now placed properly
[*] VFX - Bow impact doesn't render on top of the character anymore
[/list]

notes.title: ATAN has officially released!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]
After a few months of work, our developers are happy to share that ATAN is out of early access and now fully available! All the levels are now fully playable and come together with an ending. 

We developers would like to thank the people that have played the game over the last few months. Your feedback was extremely valuable to us and it helped us improve the game.

For the people that are new:
This game was made by 35~ passionate game developer students at Breda University of Applied Sciences over a span of 8-9 months. We hope you are going to have a fun with ATAN.

This release has come with some major changes and new things:
[list]
[*] [b]NEW:[/b] A new gameplay level 'Mijin' 
[*] The levels "Ch'ok" and "Olis" have received a lot of art improvements
[*] New achievements to get
[*] Lots of fixes to our game systems.
[/list]
[b]In case you've played the game before:[/b]
We recommend you reset your game progress by going into 'Settings -> Accessibility'.
It can be that save data can interfere with the intended player experience. 

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] The second level can't be started via the level select after unlocking 
[*] Key-rebinding can be inconsistent and may lead to issues. 
[*] On low quality settings, some materials might look out of place
[*] Changes to resolution settings can lead to issue with Graphical Settings
[*] UI - Colors for the regular & anchor arrows can be set to the wrong color
[*] Continue button doesn't skip the intro cinematic of the first level
[/list]
These issues are currently being investigated and will likely get fixed soon in hotfix patches in the coming week.

In case you want to talk or share feedback, you can join our discord server!
https://discord.gg/ryx6KWsDzn


Thanks again for joining us along on the journey.
~ The developers of Goober Inc.

notes.title: Early Access 2.0 - A Colossal Update
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]
We've been hard at work over the last few weeks and our team is glad to share the next update of ATAN. 

This update has come with some major changes and new things:
[list]
[*] [b]NEW:[/b] The onboarding level called "Ch'ok", meant to teach you how to play the game
[*] A polished version of our first level, "Olis". 
[*] Updated visuals.
[*] Lots of fixes to our core gameplay systems.
[*] Saving for checkpoints and level progress.
[/list]
Our team hopes that you will enjoy this new update. Feel free to share your feedback in our Community Server.
Also look forward to our [b]Full Release[/b] coming in two weeks on [b]June 12th, 2024[/b]!

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] The saving of settings can sometimes be inconsistent. Even though settings have been applied, the settings menu might still say 'Low Settings'
[*] Saving progress & unlocks can be inconsistent as well.
[*] Leaping from rocks can cause the player to get stuck in certain parts of the level.
[*] Incase you've played the game before, saving might be acting odd. We recommend going into the Settings -> Accessibility, and resetting your local save files. 
[*] The bow still holsters even though it hasn't been unlocked yet. 
[/list]
These issues are currently being investigated and will likely get fixed soon in a hotfix patch.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]
[list]
[*] Onboarding level has been added to teach the core systems of the game.
[*] Overall design of Level 1 has been improved.
[*] Player guidance through level 1 has been improved.
[*] Level 1 soft locks that have been found have been removed.
[*] Player movement and camera have been improved to be overall smoother.
[*] Stamina system has been reworked based on feedback.
[*] Leaping has overall improved and is more consistent.
[*] Aiming and shooting with the bow has been improved.
[*] Swinging with the rope is smoother and more consistent.
[*] Collision shapes have been improved for a better climbing experience.
[*] New player animations have been implemented for different interactions.
[*] New player IK results in improved climbing interactions with surfaces.
[*] Rope has been iterated to be more consistent and smoother.
[*] Anchors have visually improved so that they are more easily spotted.
[*] Most gameplay elements have now audio associated with them.
[*] New music tracks have been made and added in the levels.
[*] Cracks in the sky have been iterated.
[*] Some achievements have been added.
[/list]

[b]ART[/b]
[list]
[*] New master materials are getting applied through elements of game.
[*] Onboarding Level has received a first pass of set dressing.
[*] Level 1 has received a second art pass, overhauling a lot of the elements.
[*] Hero props have been added to Level 1.
[*] Models relating to gameplay have been overhauled.
[*] Post Processing shader has been added to enhance the look of the game.
[*] Player model and mask have been updated.
[*] Colossus model has been iterated and now has more elements to make it look alive.
[*] New VFX such as waterfalls and fireflies have been added through the level(s).
[*] The non-playable environment around the level has been optimized and visually improved.
[*] Lighting has been improved in the level(s).
[*] New assets for terrain and foliage have been added.
[/list]

[b]UI/UX[/b]
[list]
[*] Key rebinding has been added.
[*] Design for UI buttons has been updated.
[*] Settings menu has been visually overhauled.
[*] Stamina bar has been iterated.
[*] Level select has been added.
[*] Player respawning has been polished.
[*] Save files can now be shared across multiple devices through Steam Cloud.
[*] Checkpoints and level progress now gets saved.
[*] Graphical & Audio settings should now consistently get saved.
[/list]

And lots and lots of fixes!

notes.title: What's Ahead? (Roadmap update!)
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b] Our developers have been hard at work. We wanted to share with you guys some update on our roadmap and what to expect in the coming weeks from us.

First, we want to thank you all for playing our game and sharing it with friends and family. We are currently working hard to follow up on your feedback, [b]thanks again![/b]

[h3]Here's an update to our roadmap![/h3]

[b]EARLY ACCESS 2.0: Week of May 27th - 31th[/b]
In this update we intend to deliver an update to level 1, major bug fixes, major updates to our visuals and more! This update will also make the achievements visible, but not unlockable until full release.

[b]FULL RELEASE: June 12th.[/b]
The game will leave early access and be fully released. New content is added together with a conclusion to the game. This update also includes fixes and improvements on existing content with some quality of life updates.

Next to these two milestones our game will occasionally get some hotfix updates to fix known issues that are present in the game. After our full release we will also do hotfix updates to fix known issues.

Thanks again for checking out our game, we are excited to deliver you our vision of ATAN in the next few weeks.

notes.title: A Thank You From The Developers!
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you![/h1]
The developers of [i]Goober Inc.[/i] want to thank you for getting and playing our game!
We were astonished by the amount of players that got our game and are happy to see the positive reviews we've received so far.

So, we wanted to express our gratitude through this post. Again, [b]Thank you[/b]!

EDIT: An update post on our roadmap will be posted soon! 

That's it!
Thanks again for checking out our game, we are excited to deliver you our vision of ATAN in the next few weeks.

notes.title: Atan 'Early Access' is NOW Available!
notes.content:
We are proud to present [b]Atan[/b] on Steam! Our team has been hard at work to deliver an Early Access for you to play through. 

Atan is an action-adventure game where you scale a massive colossal. Use your climbing skills together with your bow and anchors to make your way up!

We like to remind you that this game is 'Early Access' and does not fully represent the final game yet.
A lot of work is still on the way in upcoming updates!

The game is set to fully release in a few months, and we would love it if you joined us on this journey. 
Play the game and share your feedback in our Discord server and be part of our community: [url=https://discord.gg/bQGrFwfFev]Atan - Discord Server[/url]

Atan is a student project created over the course of about 4-5 months by a team of 35 third-year students from Breda University of Applied Sciences. 

We sincerely hope you enjoy the game! Have a wonderful time!

[h2]What is in the Early Access?[/h2]
Early Access comes with the first level of the game. 
This level contains multiple climbing and puzzle sections for you to play through.
The level also received a first art pass, giving a good idea of what the final game might look like.

[h2]What is planned for the future?[/h2]
We want to deliver:
[list]
[*] An onboarding level, teaching the player how the game works
[*] A second level, more to explore! 
[*] More art in the levels
[*] Polish for themovement, rope, aiming and climbing 
[*]Lots and lots of bug fixes!
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Critical Bug - One gear isn't climbable, fix incoming soon
[*] Main Menu - Player's mask doesn't follow the head
[*] Main Menu - Player's hair isn't loaded in
[*] Gameplay - Player's climbing gear is pink
[*] Gameplay - Releasing the rope presents the 'F' key even though it's 'R'
[*] Controller Support - Pressing 'B' doesn't back you out of the settings menu ( use the keyboard/mouse instead )
[*] UI - You can open the Pause Menu over the Settings menu
[*] Anchor - Anchors sometimes disappear between narrow surfaces. 
[*] Anchor - If you shoot a moving Anchor Pillar, the rope attaches to the impact point and doesn't rotate with the pillar
[*] Art - Some of the materials glitch/warp during movement
[/list]
